bayts.text: O our Lord, bless with a blessing that wards off all corruptions that assail suddenly
toward others than us, before they make (for us), O You with Whom my harm has been effaced,
with a peace that keeps my life sound from all through which the darkness comes,
upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad, the Family and the Companions; and make my writing praiseworthy.
And make all my letters worship, O You to Whom belong the servants and worship.
And grant the best of creation, in my writing, glad tidings, O Creator Who made him the best of humankind.
And bestow on him, O Lord, on Tuesday, what belittles the quarter and the third,
of what gladdens forever and benefits, O You Who through him repel harm toward others.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing whose equal has not been seen, and whose like is not seen
among the creatures, upon him who has been preferred over all of them together, and is pre-eminent.
with a peace that is not seen nor has been seen by creation, upon him who has been made
a light for them, Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him, Lord, on Wednesday, O Everlasting Who quench and satisfy,
that for which every angel and man holily envies him, of increase and glad tidings.
And make my letters delights for him without end, in the measure of the Essence.
O our Lord, bless with a clear blessing, that heals the breasts of a believing people (Qurʾān 9:14),
with a peace that turns corruptions toward others than us, and misery, and what is corrupt,
upon him to whom my ink and my pen have given glad tidings for years, with my love.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And on Thursday grant him what surpasses the wishes, O You Who made him the trustee of the trustworthy.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing that takes away those who intended my harm, all together, and they go
toward others than me, forever, with a peace that drives away toward others than us those in whom is darkness,
upon him who turned the host of Allah, the victorious, against the people of frivolities;
and they removed the unbelievers toward others than us, as he effaced expulsion and (forced) journeys.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And threaten the enemies with a lasting threat, that turns them toward other than Your servant, the servant.
And grant him, O Lord, on Friday, what surpasses the wishes, together with what it has gathered.
O our Lord, bless with an abiding blessing, with a peace that leads precedence to me,
upon him who granted me the Book and does not turn reproach toward me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him, O Lord, on Saturday, and every day, (what is) flourishing like a shoot.
And make this blessing of mine with him the best blessing with which he has been blessed.
And write for him through it the glad tidings of Sunday, and grant him the days from Sunday on.
